title: 濠梁问答：文本、解释与改编
demo_notice: Newly written teaching example. It is not copied from the team's competition output.

sources.title: 《庄子·秋水》
sources.locator: 庄子与惠子游于濠梁之上章
sources.supports: The received text contains the fish-happiness dialogue and its argumentative turn.
sources.boundary: A transmitted philosophical text supports the passage's content, not independent proof that the exchange occurred verbatim.

sources.title: 《庄子·徐无鬼》
sources.locator: 庄子送葬过惠子之墓章
sources.supports: The received text contains the craftsman analogy told near Huizi's grave.
sources.boundary: The passage supports a literary-philosophical interpretation of intellectual companionship, not every modern biographical detail.

pages.heading: 濠梁之上
pages.narration: The received Zhuangzi places the two thinkers above the Hao River and turns a view of swimming fish into a question about how one knows another's experience.
review_notes: Do not present paraphrase as a verbatim translation.

pages.heading: 问题怎样转向
pages.narration: For this teaching adaptation, the exchange is staged as a fast argumentative reversal: a claim about fish becomes a challenge about the basis of knowledge.
review_notes: Keep the distinction between the received text and the modern staging visible.

pages.heading: 失去对手之后
pages.narration: A separate passage has Zhuangzi recall a masterful craftsman by Huizi's grave. The adaptation reads this as grief for the rare person who could meet his thought in motion.
review_notes: Describe this as an interpretation, not a settled psychological diagnosis.

collection_cards.title: 当辩论成为表演
collection_cards.body: The adaptation uses pacing and reversal to make the structure of the argument visible, while keeping the invented staging separate from the received text.
review_notes: Do not present the performance choices as historical fact.

collection_cards.title: 能接住话的人
collection_cards.body: Reading the craftsman analogy beside the Hao River dialogue suggests a modern theme of intellectual companionship; this remains an interpretation rather than a biographical certainty.
review_notes: Keep the inference visible and avoid psychological certainty.

media_plan.brief: A historically cautious, non-photoreal scene of two thinkers beside water; costume and architecture need specialist review.
A restrained memory scene with no claim to reconstruct a verified historical event; period details require review.
